description: This class includes the manufacture of dolls, toys and games (including electronic games), scale models and children's vehicles.
includes: manufacture of dolls and doll garments, doll carriages and strollers
manufacture of board games and similar games: chess, checkers, backgammon
manufacture of electronic games: video game consoles, handheld game devices
manufacture of scale models and miniature models
manufacture of children's bicycles and tricycles
manufacture of construction sets and building blocks
manufacture of puzzles of all kinds
excludes: manufacture of video game consoles (hardware), see 2640
writing and publishing of software for video games, see 5820
